# telnyx_sim_card_activation_code (Ephemeral Resource)

The activation code of an eSIM that is not installed yet, never stored in plan or state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The activation code of an eSIM, never stored in state.
ephemeral "telnyx_sim_card_activation_code" "phone" {
  sim_card_id = telnyx_sim_card.tracker.sim_card_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sim_card_id` (String) The sim card id.

### Read-Only

- `activation_code` (String, Sensitive) Contents of the eSIM activation QR code.
- `record_type` (String, Sensitive)
